proof_body:
by
  intro ζ n k _ h
  split_ifs with hd
  · rw [(h.pow_eq_one_iff_dvd k).mpr hd]
    simp
  · have hne : ζ ^ k ≠ 1 := fun e => hd ((h.pow_eq_one_iff_dvd k).mp e)
    have hmul := geom_sum_mul (ζ ^ k) n
    rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm k n, pow_mul, h.pow_eq_one, one_pow, sub_self] at hmul
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hmul).resolve_right (sub_ne_zero.mpr hne)
target_source: ∀ (ζ : ℂ) (n k : ℕ), 0 < n → IsPrimitiveRoot ζ n → ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n, (ζ ^ k) ^ j = if n ∣ k then (n : ℂ) else 0
